rules: Everything is fictional. The only brand allowed is the invented bank 'Falcon Demo Bank' (Arabic: بنك فالكون التجريبي); otherwise use generic entity names such as 'your bank', 'the courier', 'Traffic Authority', 'the telecom provider'. The national digital-identity app and identity authority may be named generically (UAE Pass, ICP) ONLY in the uae_pass_icp_impersonation scam type.
Links, when present, must be exactly of the form hxxps://example[.]test/<short-path> (defanged placeholder). Never write http:// or https:// or any other domain.
Phone numbers, when present, must be the placeholder '+971 5X XXX XXXX'. Never write real digits for a phone number.
OTP codes, reference numbers and amounts: use placeholders like 'XXXXXX' or small amounts like 'AED 350'; never a run of 5 or more digits.
Legitimate OTP notices must say the code must never be shared with anyone.
Legitimate delivery updates must contain no payment request and no link.
No real people, no real companies, no real organisations' phone numbers or addresses.
Keep each message under 400 characters, in the style of a real SMS/WhatsApp/email text.

examples.text: Falcon Demo Bank: your one-time code is XXXXXX. Never share it with anyone, including bank staff.
examples.label: legitimate

examples.text: Your parcel is held. Pay AED 12 redelivery fee today to avoid return: hxxps://example[.]test/p1
examples.label: scam
